QUOTE: `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` has `//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` commented out. `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185) are also off.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the shipped config leaves THREADING_C commented out and also leaves PTHREAD and ALT off, so the default build defines none of them. That covers both threading macros the item asks about.
